The recovered diaries and photos showed the balloon crashed on the pack ice after about two days. The men then trekked nearly 250 miles before their floating camp broke up in October 1897.

Their bodies were cremated in 1930 without further examination. Trichinosis, a bear attack, carbon monoxide and more have been proposed; the Svalbard Museum calls the cause a mystery. Sources: Wikipedia, Britannica, Svalbard Museum.
